Heart Rate Control with Landiolol Hydrochloride in Infants and Neonates During Cardiac Surgery. Perioperative tachyarrhythmias are common in children undergoing cardiac surgery, contributing to significant mortality and morbidity. Landiolol, an ultrashort-acting beta-blocker, offers selective heart rate (HR) control in pediatric patients with tachycardia during cardiac surgery.
